ex: The excellent menu is complemented by a good wine list.
佳肴佐以美酒，堪称完美无缺。

zh: 互补的；补充的；相互补足的
en: two people or things that are complementary are different but together form a useful or attractive combination of skills, qualities or physical features
ex: The school's approach must be complementary to that of the parents.
学校与家长的教育方法必须相辅相成。

en: either of two angles that together make 90°

zh: 互补色，补色（与另外一种颜色混合成为黑色或白色的颜色）
对比色（与某特定颜色形成最大色差的颜色）
en: a colour that, when mixed with another colour, gives black or white
ex: The designer has chosen the complementary colours blue and orange.
设计师选取了蓝和橙黄两种对比色。

zh: 辅助性医疗（不属于西方国家通常采用的科学疗法，如针灸）
en: medical treatment that is not part of the usual scientific treatment used in Western countries, for example acupuncture
the fact of complementing something
a word or part of a word that shows a clause is being used as a complement

zh: 包括，含有（额外部分或特征）
en: including all the parts, etc. that are necessary; whole
ex: a complete list/sequence/picture/profile
完整的列表/序列/图片/配置文件

en: in every way possible; in every part
ex: It was completely different from how I had imagined it.
这与我的想象完全不同。

en: the fact of including all the parts, etc. that are necessary; the fact of being whole
ex: the accuracy and completeness of the information
信息的准确完整性

zh: （房地产等的）完成交易，完成交割
en: the act or process of finishing something; the state of being finished and complete
ex: the completion of the new hospital building
新医院大楼的竣工

zh: 复合的（指词根加有词缀或主句含有从句）
en: made of many different things or parts that are connected; difficult to understand
ex: a complex problem/issue/process/system
复杂的问题/问题/过程/系统

en: a number consisting of a real number plus an imaginary number
the natural colour and condition of the skin on a person’s face
ex: a pale/bad complexion
苍白的／病态的脸色
